title: DatapackManager
description: This project aims to provide a simple command to save datapack from an existing world on your server. (for now)
body:
Simple plugin to save datapacks from your world to a backup folder. (for now)

Command : 
/saveDatapacks <world_name>

Save path : 
plugins/datapackmanager/backups/<worldname>

Permissions :
datapackmanager.save



The project is still in development and aims to be much bigger with many more functionalities to assist with datapacks, stay tuned and fell free to suggest upgrade or ideas. :)
